payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image still identifiable in the edited image, and if so, what is its color?
node.criteria: Track the same small rectangular DVD case visible near the center of the source image into the edited image using its shape, position, and visual continuity. Complete only if that same case is visibly white. Partial only if the same case is identifiable and visibly changed from black toward white but is not yet white. Absent if the same case remains black without a requested color change, or if it is missing/replaced and there is no visual evidence that it changed toward white. A nearby white disc or other object is not evidence of progress unless continuity establishes it is the same case. Unknown only if the images do not permit determining whether the same case changed color.
node.binding: Source target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image. Track that exact object into the edited image; do not substitute a nearby disc or other object.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.
